en: Colorized panoramic view of a historic coastal city with medieval stone walls, towers, church spires and a harbor with ships in the background. A large round tower with a green spire rises on the left, and another tall church with a pointed spire stands to the right. Trees and park-like areas surround the old city walls. The image has printed captions in Latin and Cyrillic scripts at the top.
